name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with NPM1 Somatic Mutations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues (2022)

criteria.description: Presence of ≥20% myeloblasts in peripheral blood or bone marrow
Detection of somatic mutations in the NPM1 gene by molecular genetic testing
Immunophenotypic profile consistent with myeloid lineage (e.g., CD13+, CD33+, CD34 variable)
Absence of other defining recurrent genetic abnormalities (e.g., t(8;21), inv(16))

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: ≥20% myeloblasts in blood or marrow plus confirmed NPM1 somatic mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotyping, and molecular genetics.

pathognomonic.notes: Presence of immature myeloid cells in blood smear
searchTerms: early white blood cells in blood

pathognomonic.symptomName: Bone marrow hypercellularity with myeloblast predominance
searchTerms: bone marrow with too many cells
excess immature blood cells in marrow

common.symptomName: Anemia-related pallor and dyspnea on exertion
searchTerms: pale skin and shortness of breath

common.symptomName: Thrombocytopenia leading to petechiae and easy bruising
searchTerms: easy bruising and small red spots

common.notes: Increased susceptibility to bacterial and fungal infections
searchTerms: recurrent infections due to immune weakness
infections caused by low white blood cells

common.notes: May reflect leukemic activity or infection

occasional.symptomName: Bone pain localized to long bones or sternum
searchTerms: pain in long bones or chest bone
bone tenderness in arms or legs
swollen liver and spleen felt on exam

occasional.notes: Less common in AML compared to lymphoid leukemias

searchTerms: losing weight and sweating at night

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with neurological deficits
rare.notes: Leukemic infiltration of CNS is uncommon
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to CNS involvement

rare.notes: Due to high blast counts obstructing microvasculature
searchTerms: lung problems from blood cell buildup

rare.notes: More frequent in certain AML subtypes but can occur

laboratory: Complete blood count with anemia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia
imaging: Chest X-ray may show infiltrates if leukostasis or infection present
Ultrasound or CT may reveal hepatosplenomegaly
other: Bone marrow biopsy demonstrating hypercellularity with myeloblast predominance
Flow cytometry immunophenotyping consistent with myeloid blasts

distinguishingFeatures: Dysplastic changes in marrow with <20% blasts

redFlags: Signs of leukostasis such as respiratory distress or neurological deficits
Unexplained severe thrombocytopenia with bleeding manifestations
